english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for cooking food in boiling water.
Use 煮 when preparing food means actually cooking it rather than merely arranging it.

examples.english: We boil some vegetables in boiling water.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 gwan2 seoi2 zyu2 di1 coi3

examples.english: Prepare the chicken wings by cooking them thoroughly before eating.
examples.jyutping: nei5 zyu2 suk6 di1 gai1 jik6 sin1 sik6 laa1
